title: Cosmic Energy Being
description: A glowing humanoid figure with multiple branching arms stands inside a transparent spherical energy field. The figure has a large dark head with white star-like eyes and is connected to a Tesla-coil style base emitting vibrant lightning-like energy tendrils in purple, blue, and yellow.
prompt: A surreal cosmic scene featuring a translucent humanoid figure with multiple branching energy arms standing inside a large glowing sphere. The figure has a large dark head with bright star-shaped white eyes and is mounted on a black Tesla coil base. Bright purple, blue, and yellow lightning energy radiates from its body. The background is a swirling nebula of fiery orange, red, and deep blue with floating colorful orbs and stars.
